description: Build a buy in one call: quotes six routers and returns the best route as a transaction for the key's wallet to sign. Give tokenId or token, and amountUsd (paid in USDG) or amountIn with tokenIn. The TRNCH fee (0.5%) is already deducted from the quote. Returns { router, quote, approval, tx, chainId, from }: if approval is not null, send it first, then sign and send tx from the same wallet (chainId 4663). Nothing is sent by TRNCH. Errors: 409 token not tradable through TRNCH (kept out by TIA), 429 rate or build limit (retry-after). Requires the API key from trnch_register, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn to spend, smallest unit. Use this or amountUsd.

amountUsd.description: Amount to spend in US dollars, paid in USDG. Use this or amountIn.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (100 = 1%). Default 100.

token.description: Token to buy, as an address. Use this or tokenId.

tokenId.description: Opaque token id from trnch_heat (field id). Use this or token.

tokenIn.description: Token paid with amountIn. Default USDG.

name: trnch_buy
title: Buy a token
